tasks.title: Email to your English teacher
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.subject: Football club finals – planning
paragraphs: As you know, our youth football club has reached the finals next month. We need to decide on a few things to prepare well.
First, should we have extra training sessions on weekday evenings or on Saturday mornings? Which do you think is better for the team?
Also, we need to choose a team activity to build team spirit. Would you prefer a team dinner or a fun sports day?
Finally, can you suggest one thing we should do to support the players before the big match?
Let me know your ideas! Best wishes, Mrs. Hill

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which training time you prefer and why.
Choose a team activity (dinner or sports day) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to support the players before the match.
Ask Mrs. Hill about the match day schedule.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Article for a specialist magazine
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: How can a youth football club build team spirit before important matches?
What activity from your club was especially effective?
Why would you recommend it to other clubs?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website!

tasks.title: Story
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When the programme coordinator announced that the final match was cancelled, everyone stared in silence."
